method: Automated smoke evaluation via tests/eval.smoke.test.ts. For each case, synthetic documents were chunked, embedded with a deterministic keyword-hash mock embedder, upserted into MemoryVectorStore, retrieved (topK=3), then passed to a deterministic mock language model. Retrieval and generation evaluated separately.
limitations: Measured on tiny synthetic smoke dataset (n=3); not statistically meaningful and not evidence of production or domain quality.
Mock embedding and generation models were used; results do not reflect real provider/model behavior, latency, cost, or faithfulness under realistic conditions.
No nDCG@K, human-judged faithfulness/answer relevance, context precision/recall, latency percentiles, or cost-per-query were measured in this run.
